verses.geez: ዝክሩ፡ ለኢዮስያስ፡ ሠናይ፡ ዝክረ፡ ጥበብ፡ ከመ፡ ዕፍረት፡ ዘቅድው፡ መዐዛሁ፡ ወጥዑም፡ ከመ፡ መዓር፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ አፍ፡ ወከመ፡ ማሕሌት፡ ውስተ፡ ስታይ።
verses.translation: The remembrance of Josias is like the composition of the perfume that is made by the art of the apothecary: it is sweet as honey in all mouths, and as music at a banquet of wine.

translations.lxx: The remembrance of Josias is like the composition of the perfume that is made by the art of the apothecary: it is sweet as honey in all mouths, and as music at a banquet of wine.
translations.ron: Pomenirea lui Iosia este binemirositoare ca tocmirea tămâiei, meşteşugită de făcătorul de miresme.
translations.grk: Μνημόσυνον Ἰωσίου εἰς σύνθεσιν θυμιάματος, ἐσκευασμένον ἔργῳ μυρεψοῦ, ἐν παντὶ στόματι ὡς μέλι γλυκανθήσεται, καὶ ὡς μουσικὰ ἐν συμποσίῳ οἴνου.

verses.geez: ወውእቱ፡ ረትዐ፡ ወሜጦሙ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ወአእተተ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ርኵስ።
verses.translation: He behaved himself uprightly in the conversion of the people, and took away the abominations of iniquity.

translations.lxx: He behaved himself uprightly in the conversion of the people, and took away the abominations of iniquity.
translations.ron: În toată gura, ca mierea se va îndulci şi ca muzica la ospăţul vinului.
translations.grk: Αὐτὸς κατευθύνθη ἐν ἐπιστροφῇ λαοῦ, καὶ ἐξῇρε βδελύγματα ἀνομίας.

verses.geez: ወአርትዐ፡ ልቦ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወበመዋዕለ፡ ኀጥኣን፡ አጽንዓ፡ ለጽድቅ።
verses.translation: He directed his heart unto the Lord, and in the time of the ungodly he established the worship of God.

translations.lxx: He directed his heart unto the Lord, and in the time of the ungodly he established the worship of God.
translations.ron: Acesta a îndreptat şi a întors poporul şi a stricat urâciunile fărădelegii.
translations.grk: Κατεύθυνε πρὸς Κύριον τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ, ἐν ἡμέραις ἀνόμων κατίσχυσε τὴν εὐσέβειαν.

verses.geez: ዳዊት፡ ዳእሙ፡ ወሕዝቅያስ፡ ወኢዮስያስ፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ እልክቱሰ፡ አበሱ፡ ወጌገዩ፡ ወኀደጉ፡ ሕጎ፡ ለልዑል፡ ወኀልቁ፡ ነገሥተ፡ ይሁዳ።
verses.translation: All, except David and Ezekias and Josias, were defective: for they forsook the law of the most High, even the kings of Juda failed;

translations.lxx: All, except David and Ezekias and Josias, were defective: for they forsook the law of the most High, even the kings of Juda failed;
translations.ron: A îndreptat către Domnul inima sa, în zilele celor fără de lege, a întărit dreapta credinţă.
translations.grk: Πάρεξ Δαυὶδ, καὶ Ἐζεκίου, καὶ Ἰωσίου, πάντες πλημμέλειαν ἐπλημμέλησαν· κατέλιπον γὰρ τὸν νόμον τοῦ ὑψίστου, οἱ βασιλεῖς Ἰούδα ἐξέλιπον.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አግብኡ፡ ቀርኖሙ፡ ለባዕድ፡ ወክብሮሙኒ፡ ለካልእ፡ ሕዝብ።
verses.translation: for they gave their power unto others, and their glory to a strange nation.

translations.lxx: for they gave their power unto others, and their glory to a strange nation.
translations.ron: Afară de David şi de Iezechia şi de Iosia, toţi au păcătuit.
translations.grk: Ἔδωκαν γὰρ τὸ κέρας αὐτῶν ἑτέροις, καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν ἔθνει ἀλλοτρίῳ.

verses.geez: ወአውዐይዋ፡ ለሀገር፡ ኅሪት፡ ወቅድስት፡ ወአጥፍኡ፡ ፍናዊሃ፡ በእደ፡ ኤርምያስ።
verses.translation: They burnt the chosen city of the sanctuary, and made the streets desolate, according to the prophecy of Jeremias.

translations.lxx: They burnt the chosen city of the sanctuary, and made the streets desolate, according to the prophecy of Jeremias.
translations.ron: Pentru că au părăsit legea Celui Preaînalt, regii lui Iuda au încetat, pentru că au dat puterea lor altora şi mărirea lor neamului străin.
translations.grk: Ἐνεπύρισαν ἐκλεκτὴν πόλιν ἁγιάσματος, καὶ ἠρήμωσαν τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῆς ἐν χειρὶ Ἱερεμίου.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ሣቀይዎ፡ ወውእቱሰ፡ እምከርሠ፡ እሙ፡ ተቀደሰ፡ ይኩን፡ ነቢየ፡ ከመ፡ ይሠሩ፡ ወከመ፡ ያጥፍእ፡ ወከማሁ፡ ከመ፡ ይትክል፡ ወከመ፡ ይሕንጽ።
verses.translation: For they entreated him evil, who nevertheless was a prophet, sanctified in his mother's womb, that he might root out, and afflict, and destroy; and that he might build up also, and plant.

translations.lxx: For they entreated him evil, who nevertheless was a prophet, sanctified in his mother's womb, that he might root out, and afflict, and destroy; and that he might build up also, and plant.
translations.ron: Au ars cetatea cea aleasă a sfinţirii şi au pustiit căile ei, din pricina lui Ieremia,
translations.grk: Ἐκάκωσαν γὰρ αὐτὸν, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν μήτρᾳ ἡγιάσθη προφήτης ἐκριζοῦν καὶ κακοῦν καὶ ἀπολλύειν, ὡσαύτως οἰκοδομεῖν καὶ καταφυτεύειν.

verses.geez: ወሕዝቅኤልኒ፡ ዘርእየ፡ ርእየተ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ ወርእዩ፡ ላእለ፡ ሠረገላ፡ ዘኪሩቤል።
verses.translation: It was Ezekiel who saw the glorious vision, which was shewed him upon the chariot of the cherubim.

translations.lxx: It was Ezekiel who saw the glorious vision, which was shewed him upon the chariot of the cherubim.
translations.ron: Că l-au chinuit pe el, care din pântece s-a sfinţit prooroc, ca să dezrădăcineze şi să necăjească şi să piardă şi asemenea să zidească şi să sădească.
translations.grk: Ἰεζεκιὴλ ὃς εἶδεν ὅρασιν δόξης, ἣν ὑπέδειξεν αὐτῷ ἐπὶ ἅρματος χερουβίμ.

verses.geez: ወዘከሮሙ፡ በመዐት፡ ለፀር፡ ወበሠናይ፡ አርትዐ፡ ፍናዎሙ፡ ለጻድቃን።
verses.translation: For he made mention of the enemies under the figure of the rain, and directed them that went right.

translations.lxx: For he made mention of the enemies under the figure of the rain, and directed them that went right.
translations.ron: Iezechiel a văzut vedenia măririi, care i s-a arătat lui prin carul heruvimilor.
translations.grk: Καὶ γὰρ ἐμνήσθη τῶν ἐχθρῶν ἐν ὄμβρῳ, καὶ ἀγαθῶσαι τοὺς εὐθύνοντας ὁδούς.

verses.geez: ወሠረጸ፡ አዕጽምቲሆሙ፡ ለዐሠርቱ፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ ነቢያት፡ በመካኖሙ። ወአስተፍሥሖ፡ ለያዕቆብ፡ ወቤዘዎሙ፡ በሃይማኖተ፡ ተስፋሆሙ።
verses.translation: And of the twelve prophets let the memorial be blessed, and let their bones flourish again out of their place: for they comforted Jacob, and delivered them by assured hope.

translations.lxx: And of the twelve prophets let the memorial be blessed, and let their bones flourish again out of their place: for they comforted Jacob, and delivered them by assured hope.
translations.ron: Şi mi-aduc aminte şi de Iov, care a ţinut bine toate căile dreptăţii.
translations.grk: Καὶ τῶν δώδεκα προφητῶν τὰ ὀστᾶ ἀναθάλοι ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῶν· παρεκάλεσε δὲ τὸν Ἰακὼβ, καὶ ἐλυτρώσατο αὐτοὺς ἐν πίστει ἐλπίδος.

verses.geez: እፎኑ፡ እንጋ፡ ናዐብዮ፡ ለዘሩባቤል፡ ወውእቱሰ፡ ከመ፡ ኅልቀተ፡ ማዕተብ፡ ውስተ፡ ዕደ፡ የማን።
verses.translation: How shall we magnify Zorobabel? he was even as a signet on the right hand:

translations.lxx: How shall we magnify Zorobabel? he was even as a signet on the right hand:
translations.ron: şi oasele celor doisprezece prooroci să odrăslească din locul lor!
translations.grk: Πῶς μεγαλύνωμεν τὸν Ζοροβάβελ; καὶ αὐτὸς ὡς σφραγὶς ἐπὶ δεξιᾶς χειρός.

verses.geez: ወኢዮሴዕኒ፡ ወልደ፡ ዮሴዴቅ፡ እለ፡ ሐነጹ፡ ቤተ፡ በመዋዕሊሆሙ፡ ወአዕበይዎ፡ [ለሕዝብ፡]እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘድልው፡ ለክብር፡ ዘለዓለም።
verses.translation: So was Jesus the son of Josedec: who in their time builded the house, and set up an holy temple to the Lord, which was prepared for everlasting glory.

translations.lxx: So was Jesus the son of Josedec: who in their time builded the house, and set up an holy temple to the Lord, which was prepared for everlasting glory.
translations.ron: Şi a mângâiat pe Iacov şi i-a mântuit pe ei cu credinţa nădejdii.
translations.grk: Οὕτως Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Ἰωσεδέκ· οἳ ἐν ἡμέραις αὐτῶν ᾠκοδόμησαν οἴκον, καὶ ἀνύψωσαν λαὸν ἅγιον Κυρίῳ ἡτοιμασμένον εἰς δόξαν αἰῶνος.

verses.geez: ወለነሐምያን፡ ብዙኅ፡ ዝክሩ፡ [ዘ]አንሥአ፡ ለነ፡ አረፍተ፡ ውድቅተ፡ ወአቀመ፡ ኆኅተ፡ ወገብረ፡ መናሥግተ፡ ወሐነጸ፡ ለነ፡ አብያቲነ።
verses.translation: And among the elect was Neemias, whose renown is great, who raised up for us the walls that were fallen, and set up the gates and the bars, and raised up our ruins again.

translations.lxx: And among the elect was Neemias, whose renown is great, who raised up for us the walls that were fallen, and set up the gates and the bars, and raised up our ruins again.
translations.ron: Cum vom mări pe Zorobabel? Că şi el este ca o pecete în mâna dreaptă.
translations.grk: Καὶ Νεεμίου ἐπὶ πολὺ τὸ μνημόσυνον, τοῦ ἐγείραντος ἡμῖν τείχη πεπτωκότα, καὶ στήσαντος πύλας καὶ μοχλοὺς, καὶ ἀνεγείραντος τὰ οἰκόπεδα ἡμῶν.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ዘተፈጥረ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ዘከመ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ወሎቱኒ፡ ነሥእዎ፡ እምነ፡ ብሔር።
verses.translation: But upon the earth was no man created like Enoch; for he was taken from the earth.

translations.lxx: But upon the earth was no man created like Enoch; for he was taken from the earth.
translations.ron: Tot aşa Iosua, fiul lui Iosedec; căci în zilele lor au zidit iarăşi locaşul Domnului şi au înălţat templu sfinţit Domnului, spre mărire veşnică.
translations.grk: Οὐδὲ εἷς ἐκτίσθη οἷος Ἐνὼχ τοιοῦτος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, καὶ γὰρ αὐτὸς ἀνελήφθη ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez: ወኢተወልደ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘከመ፡ ዮሴፍ፡ መልአከ፡ ኮነ፡ ለአኀዊሁ፡ ወኀይለ፡ ኮነ፡ ለሕዝቡ፡ ወሣህለ፡ ረከበ፡ ለአዕፅምቲሁ።
verses.translation: Neither was there a man born like unto Joseph, a governor of his brethren, a stay of the people, whose bones were regarded of the Lord.

translations.lxx: Neither was there a man born like unto Joseph, a governor of his brethren, a stay of the people, whose bones were regarded of the Lord.
translations.ron: Şi pomenirea lui Neemia este întru multă vreme, cel ce ne-a ridicat nouă zidurile cele căzute şi a întărit porţi şi izvoare şi a ridicat casele noastre.
translations.grk: Οὐδὲ ὡς Ἰωσὴφ ἐγεννήθη ἀνὴρ, ἡγούμενος ἀδελφῶν, στήριγμα λαοῦ, καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ αὐτοῦ ἐπεσκέπησαν.

verses.geez: ሴም፡ ወሴት፡ ከብሩ፡ እምእጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወአዳምኒ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ሕያው፡ ዘተፈጥረ።
verses.translation: Sem and Seth were in great honour among men, and so was Adam above every living thing in the creation.

translations.lxx: Sem and Seth were in great honour among men, and so was Adam above every living thing in the creation.
translations.ron: Nici unul nu s-a făcut ca Enoh pe pământ, pentru că şi el a fost răpit de pe pământ.
translations.grk: Σὴμ καὶ Σὴθ ἐν ἀνθρώποις ἐδοξάσθησαν, καὶ ὑπὲρ πᾶν ζῶον ἐν τῇ κτίσει Ἀδάμ.
